title: GPHome
description: Paper plugin for GriefPrevention land teleportation
body:
# GPHome
GPHome is a simple way to let players teleport to their GriefPrevention claims.

Previously, players had to set a home on their land if they wanted to teleport there, for example: to a mob farm or team base. Players who didn't set a home either had to walk or ask an admin to teleport them.

This plugin can be a solution to this problem. Players can teleport without asking an admin, making it easier to work on projects on their land.

![A demo of gphome command](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81908aefe3c80dc2d69d864c55974dff4e16d5b2.gif)

## Requirements
- PaperMC or any fork (Version >= 1.21.11)
- GriefPrevention (Version >= 16.18.7)

## Note
- My plugin is not sponsored or approved by GriefPrevention developers, this plugin is just an unofficial additional feature.
